# TASK-169 — specification

## Scope

Ask for the draft again without retyping: `POST /projects/:id/draft` uses the project description when no sentence is sent (400 with a clear message when there is none), and Overview shows "Draft the essentials with AI" to editors when the AI is on, the project has a description and an essential answer is missing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] (2026-10-09) The draft can be asked for again from Overview; with no sentence sent, the project description is the sentence.
- [x] No new stored field.
